local_saved_intake_replay.question: Find Dutch public procurement notices for cleaning services through TenderNed. Shortlist relevant notices with the buyer, scope, publication type, available deadline and source link. Distinguish contract opportunities from notices of already awarded contracts.

sources.description: Browse Dutch public government contracts and procurement notices in the Netherlands via TenderNed. No keyword or company identifier required; optional literal search/date/sector filters. One page of 20, sorted by publication date. Preserve notice types: announcements, awards, corrections and cancellations. Not all are open tenders or awarded contracts; no full contract PDFs.
